title: unified-rollouts-enhanced-preflight-autorollback-workflow
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for automated rollouts by adding a preflight probing stage, metric quorum enforcement, and a quarantine stage for noisy metrics. This PR introduces a new rollout orchestration state 'preflight' that executes staged shadow probing with configurable probes, enforces composite metric quorums (latency, error-rate, quality regressions), and integrates automatic quarantine and auto-rollback logic when quorum cannot be satisfied. The goal is to reduce false-positive rollbacks from noisy signals and to prevent unhealthy canary promotions while preserving fast rollouts for stable models.

Summary of changes: added orchestration state and controller hooks, new preflight/probing service with scheduling and retry/backoff logic, metric quorum evaluator, quarantine stage and manual-unquarantine workflow, expanded telemetry (rollout_id, preflight_id, probe_shard tags), migration script for existing rollouts, console UI updates to surface preflight status and probe traces, and e2e tests that exercise common failure modes.

Key behaviors: 1) Preflight runs as a light-weight shadow/probing phase before any traffic weight is shifted to a canary. 2) A metric quorum must be satisfied across a configurable subset of metrics (default: p95 latency, request_error_rate, quality_regression_score) before promotion. 3) If quorum is not met but individual metrics are noisy, the rollout enters 'quarantine' where additional probes are run against a longer sample window; quarantine can be escalated to manual review. 4) Auto-rollback thresholds are tightened during preflight; severe regressions trigger immediate rollback and short-circuit promotion. 5) Rollout engine now supports freezing weights and exponential backoff for retries when transient infra issues are detected.

Compatibility and flags: this change is guarded by a feature flag (rollouts.preflight_v2) scoped at the org level. Existing rollouts default to current behavior until the flag is enabled. Migration script safely augments persisted rollout records with the preflight state and is idempotent.

Testing and validation: added unit tests for quorum evaluator and probe scheduler, integration e2e tests to cover promotion, quarantine, and rollback flows, and a set of synthetic load tests. Observability changes include new metrics (rollout.preflight.probes_total, rollout.preflight.quarantine_count, rollout.preflight.quorum_failures) and Grafana dashboards/alerts to detect stuck preflights.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement preflight orchestration state and controller hooks
- [x] Add probe scheduler and retry/backoff semantics
- [x] Metric quorum evaluator and composite threshold rules
- [x] Quarantine stage + manual-unquarantine API
- [x] Console UI for preflight status and probe traces
- [x] Migration script + data safety review
- [x] Unit, integration, and e2e tests
- [x] Observability (metrics, dashboards, alerts)

Related work: builds on earlier autorollback and observability PRs (ENG-3121, ENG-3189). Linear: ENG-3245 (preflight rollout engine), ENG-3278 (preflight telemetry). Support ticket SUP-8812 requested safer canary promotions for a high-traffic customer and motivated the quarantine stage.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the quorum evaluator correctness, the idempotency of the migration script, and the interaction between freeze-weight and autoscaling policies. The feature flag makes it easy to roll back if any customer-wide issues are observed.

review_comments: Miguel Torres: Nice work — the preflight state model looks clean. Two asks: add metrics for probe latency distribution and ensure the controller won't spin on quota errors. Please add a unit test for quota retry backoff.
Ava Chen (author): Thanks Miguel — added probe latency histogram metric and updated the scheduler to short-circuit on quota errors. Added unit test `test_quota_backoff`.
Priya Patel: Concern about migration: what happens if a long-running rollout record is mutated mid-migration? Please make migration idempotent and add a safety lock.
Ava Chen: Migration now uses DB advisory locks and is idempotent; added notes in migration file and added an integration test that simulates concurrent migration attempts.

Ethan Gray: Observability/alerts look good. Request: include rollout_id in the trace context for probe spans. Also noticed an edge case where freeze-weight+autoscaler can deadlock — added a suggested fix in comment.
Ava Chen: Applied the trace context change and adopted Ethan's autoscaler fix. Added e2e that covers freeze/unfreeze interactions.
Miguel Torres: CI initially failed on load-tests, but rerun after the scheduler tuning shows stable behavior. Approving now.
Ethan Gray: Approve with comment: watch the alerts for the first week after rollout when enabling the flag org-wide.
merge_outcome: merged into main after CI green and approvals
release_notes:
- Add preflight probing stage for unified rollouts (feature-flagged)
- Enforce metric quorum and composite thresholds before promotion
- Add quarantine stage for noisy metrics and manual-unquarantine workflow
- New telemetry: rollout.preflight.* metrics and probe traces
- Console: rollout inspector displays preflight/probe status
- Migration script to add preflight state to existing rollouts
notes: Feature gated; recommend staged enablement with canary orgs first. Monitor rollout.preflight.quorum_failures and stuck preflight alerts during initial ramp.
